Name: Marricka Scott-McFadden - Democratic Elections Commissioner for Bronx County.
Title: RESOLUTION APPROVING THE APPOINTMENT BY THE COUNCIL OF MARRICKA SCOTT-MCFADDEN AS THE BRONX COUNTY DEMOCRATIC COMMISSIONER OF ELECTIONS.
BodyName: Committee on Rules, Privileges, Elections, Standards and Ethics

History.Description: This Resolution was Approved by Committee
History.BodyName: Committee on Rules, Privileges, Elections, Standards and Ethics

Text:
RESOLVED, that pursuant to § 3-204 of the New York State Election Law, the Council does hereby approve the appointment of Marricka Scott-McFadden as the Bronx County Democratic Commissioner of Elections to fill an existing vacancy in said office that expires on December 31, 2028.   



COUPLED ON GO
